options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name of the group (via aria-labelledby).

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial duration; also the value restored by reset(). Non-negative and a whole number of the smallest unit in fields.

options.name: min
options.description: Inclusive lower bound for validation and stepping (non-negative). Stepping stops at zero when unset. Must not exceed max.

options.name: max
options.description: Inclusive upper bound for validation and stepping (non-negative); also sets the digits and aria-valuemax of the largest segment.

options.name: step
options.description: Increment of the smallest segment and the valid-value grid from zero. Positive and a whole number of the smallest unit.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name for the hidden input (ISO 8601 duration, for example PT1H30M).

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by the group's aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: An empty entry is invalid; segments are required and the required indicator is shown.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Focusable and submitted; not editable, and stepping, Home/End, and separators are ignored.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation after built-in checks; return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: fields
options.description: Unit segments, largest first, as a contiguous non-empty run of 'days' | 'hours' | 'minutes' | 'seconds'.

options.name: locale
options.description: Segment names, unit text and its position, aria-valuetext, durations in messages, and messages.

options.name: direction
options.description: Direction of the group; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight follow it.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: group
properties.description: The labelled role=group with one spinbutton segment per unit.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value; null when empty or failing a built-in check (a custom error from validate or setCustomError keeps the value, as in Time Picker).

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value, or a partial or invalid entry exists.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic value (no events); clears an external custom error. Throws DURATION_PICKER_OPTIONS for a negative value or one that is not a whole number of the smallest unit.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; a fields, locale, or max change rebuilds the segments and keeps the current value.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: ISO 8601 duration in hours, minutes, and seconds (PT1H30M), or null when empty or invalid.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state (no events).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, form registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user changed the value or its validity error (typing, stepping, Home/End, or a separator).

cssClasses.name: aui-duration-picker__group
cssClasses.description: Labelled group; control boundary and focus indicator.

cssClasses.name: aui-duration-picker__unit | __unit--days | --hours | --minutes | --seconds
cssClasses.description: Wrapper of one segment and its unit text.
